title: The Abu Dhabi Swap: Prisoner Deal Stalls Peace Talks
description: Russia and Ukraine agree to a major prisoner exchange in Abu Dhabi, but territorial disputes and trust deficits stall broader peace efforts. We break down the deal, the diplomatic routes, and what comes next.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What happens when two enemies agree to swap prisoners but refuse to stop the war? We track the Abu Dhabi deal, the diplomatic routes, and why territory remains a hard line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two days of U.S.-brokered peace talks concluded in Abu Dhabi on November 11. Mediators say a major prisoner exchange was agreed in principle, though final numbers are still being tallied.

lines.text: In principle, yes. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner called it the "biggest humanitarian release" of this war, though Kyiv and Moscow haven't published exact figures yet.

lines.text: So it's basically a handshake on paper while the missiles keep flying?

lines.speaker: diplomat
lines.text: Precisely. They agreed to determine the numbers on Thursday, but territorial disputes remain completely unresolved.
